description.value: Dragon Bowl is a fast-casual Chinese restaurant chain founded in 2022, located in Vancouver's West End near Alberni and Thurlow streets. It specializes in customizable rice bowls, noodle bowls, protein-packed salads, and bubble tea made with fresh, natural ingredients blending traditional Chinese flavors with modern preparation. With online ordering, quick service, and a focus on healthy and affordable meals, it makes a convenient stop for cyclists moving through downtown Vancouver.
